text:
marina: Quick heads-up: onboarding sample-app started returning mixed-dimension embeddings after I switched to the new batcher helper. Some items 1536, some 768.

devon: can you paste the request + a tiny response?

marina: request (trimmed): `{'model':'embed-x','inputs':['a','b','c'],'batching':{'async':true}}`
response (trimmed): `[{'id':null,'embedding':[...1536 floats...]},{'id':null,'embedding':[...768 floats...]},{'id':null,'embedding':[...1536 floats...]}]`

ash: sounds like a retry/partial-batch issue where different slices hit different model variants. Are you using per-item ids?

marina: no, sample-app calls `batcher.send(texts)` with no stable ids. I assumed order preserved.

devon: repro I did: force a transient 500 on worker -> batcher retries partial payload -> retry lands in other region with older embed bundle (lower dim). Client zips by order and ends up with mixed dims.

ash: actionable items: (1) SDK/batcher should attach item ids and an x-idempotency-key by default; (2) SDK should preserve mapping when merging async responses and assert equal dims; (3) runtime should include per-item metadata (model, embedding_dim) or reject merges across dims.

marina: I'll patch sample-app to attach `item_id` and add a check that all embedding lengths equal before zipping. Will open PR.

ops-bot: sample-app branch fix/batcher-ids CI started.

devon: also saw rerank issue: when ids missing the returned `scores` array can be in processing order which breaks mapping. Temporary mitigation: map id->score prior to applying ranking.

ash: let's add an integration test that simulates partial retry + cross-region routing so CI catches silent mixed-dim returns. I'll open SDK issue to track parity across languages.

marina: noted. customer guidance meanwhile: set `batching.async=false` or pass explicit item ids. We'll update onboarding docs.

devon: created issues rwi/sdk# and rwi/runtime# to track. We'll follow up with SDK patch and runtime response metadata change.

marina: thanks all, PR at https://git.redwood/infra/sampleapp/pull/999 (draft). Leaving thread until SDK patch lands.
